title: Weight-only quant verifier: heterogenous-fleet GPTQ/AWQ regression & smoke harness
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an automated verification harness and CI/regression pipeline that validates INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ and AWQ variants) across Redwood's heterogeneous serving fleet (NVidia GPU kernels, AMD GPU kernels, CPU AVX paths, and quant-specific microkernels). The harness must detect accuracy regressions, surface kernel-level incompatibilities, and produce actionable telemetry for rollback/playbook automation.
summary: Deliver a deterministic smoke + nightly regression suite that compares quantized weight-only variants against FP16 baselines across representative workloads (completion, instruction-following, embeddings) and enforces acceptance windows per model-family and task.
acceptance_criteria: Smoke job runs in < 10 minutes and returns pass/fail for each model-family on each hardware class
Nightly regression collects historical deltas and triggers an alert when median quality metric falls outside configured tolerance for > 3 consecutive runs
Regression job produces per-example diffs, sample-level seed, prompt, and canonical expected outputs for investigation
Automated canary gating step integrated with deployment pipeline that blocks rollout when a quant variant fails the canary thresholds
Artifacts (CSV/Parquet) of telemetry are stored to s3://redwood-quant-regressions/YYYY-MM-DD and linked in the job run
tasks: Define representative model-family matrix (Llama-family 7B/13B, Falcon 7B, Redstone-7B) and map to quant variants: GPTQ-int8, AWQ-int8, FP8-experimental
Curate prompt sets per task: generation (30 prompts), instruction-following (50 prompts), embeddings (100 pairs) — include multilingual and edge-cases
Implement runner that boots containers with target kernel (container tags: quant-gpu-nv, quant-gpu-amd, quant-cpu-avx) and executes deterministic sampling seeded by job
Add statistical comparison module: bootstrap confidence intervals for mean logprob delta and cosine similarity; perform paired test and report p-value
Wire job into CI: quick-smoke (post-PR), canary (pre-rollout), nightly-regression (longer sample & historical retention)
Create a lightweight dashboard (Grafana) for delta-trends and an alert rule when drift > configured threshold
progress_updates: 2026-02-21: Kickoff with Runtime and Serving teams. Mapped initial hardware matrix and identified missing kernel images for AMD GPU (action: eng-ops to build).

Design (Leo Martin): include a minimal UI flow in the Console for 'Regression details' linking to sample diffs

test_plan: Smoke: 5 prompts per task, run across all kernels; total budget ~8 minutes. Pass when median cosine similarity drop < 0.02 and mean logprob delta < 0.3
Canary: 30 prompts, full seed replay enabled; block rollout when >5% of prompts have output tokens flagged by hallucination detector or when significance test p < 0.01 for a drop in metric
Nightly: 200 prompts / 100 embedding pairs; compute bootstrap CIs, store full per-example diffs, and retain 90 days of history
Failure triage: collect model state (version/hash), quant profile metadata, kernel image tag, full prompt+seed, and sampling RNG state when available
telemetry_metrics: quant_fallback_count (automatic fallback to compatible model variant)
rollout_plan: PR phase: run quick-smoke in CI for any change touching quant code or kernel selector; block merge on failures
Pre-rollout canary: deploy quant variant to small %, run canary job; require 48h stable window with no regression alerts
Gradual rollout: 10% -> 30% -> 60% with nightly regression checks; automated rollback if 2 consecutive nightly runs show regression beyond tolerance
Emergency rollback: if customer_impact == high or SLA errors increase, trigger immediate downgrade to FP16 variant with traffic re-route script
